rca of the issue: Root cause: during the useMemo refactor in iteration 5, two related useMemo hooks were introduced in PropertyDetailPage.js in the wrong source order. `calendarDisabledRules = useMemo(() => [{before: new Date()}, ...disabledDates], [disabledDates])` is declared on line 108, but `disabledDates = useMemo(...)` is declared on line 113. When React first evaluates the component, JavaScript evaluates hook declarations top-down; referencing `disabledDates` inside the first useMemo's factory — invoked inline during evaluation — hits the TDZ because `const disabledDates` has not yet been initialized. Result: ReferenceError, error boundary activates, page blank. Reproduction: open any https://<host>/property/<slug>. Mitigation: swap the two useMemo blocks so `disabledDates` is declared first. No other file in the refactored set (HomePage, AdminDashboard, BookingPage, DocumentUpload, PropertyFormDialog, AuthContext) exhibits this pattern — spot-checked via grep.
